findings.rationale: Several result variants are classified as successful when their required sibling verdict field is absent or has the wrong type: approval_check accepts every status except signature-invalid, format_check accepts a missing/non-boolean changed field, and lint and semantic_diff use is_none_or to treat malformed fields as clean. A producer/schema regression can therefore be admitted as success and permit a zero process exit instead of being treated as an internal inconsistency. Require the expected field and exact success value/type for each variant, failing closed otherwise.
